task: filtered, leakage-controlled six-class GoEmotions-derived task; not the unchanged published benchmark

glove.description: Pre-trained vectors based on Wikipedia 2014 + Gigaword, 5.6B tokens, 400K vocab, uncased (https://nlp.stanford.edu/projects/glove/).
glove.preprocessing: Converted to w2v format with `python -m gensim.scripts.glove2word2vec -i <fname> -o glove-wiki-gigaword-50.txt`.

terms.dataset: Dataset card declares Apache-2.0; source LICENSE retained. English Reddit comments may include offensive content; original dataset limitations apply.
terms.embedding: Gensim resource metadata specifies PDDL; underlying GloVe Wikipedia 2014 + Gigaword 5 provenance retained.
terms.model: DistilBERT Apache-2.0 LICENSE and model card retained.
terms.access: Public unauthenticated downloads succeeded in cloud; Hugging Face/GitHub service terms also apply.

recurrent_encoded_collisions.policy: Audit only: no score-dependent filtering; all models keep the same records.

transformer_encoded_collisions.policy: Audit only: no score-dependent filtering; all models keep the same records.

cap_policy: Train p99.5 >128 =>256, otherwise128; head truncation; audit residual truncation
identity_policy: NFC + whitespace collapse + casefold; punctuation retained; duplicate connected groups by source ID OR normalized full text
